title: Pourquoi les Français font toujours grève ? (Versão Viral)
style_reference: Clean full-bleed 2D cartoon style inspired by @mrfrisson (NO UI, NO borders, bold black outlines, vibrant cel-shaded colors)

timeline.dialogue_fr: En France, si ta rue est calme le matin... vérifie ton passeport, t'es sûrement pas en France !

seedance_prompt.prompt: 2D cartoon animation, @mrfrisson style, clean full-bleed 9:16. Jean-Baguette holding a coffee mug by his window, eyes popping in shock as yellow-vest protesters march outside. Fast camera push-in, expressive French lip-sync.
